```{r,ST36_map_of_movmenets}

library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(maps)
library(grid)  

#### 1) Data inputs adn cleaning 


df <- read_csv(
  "ST36_map_location.csv",
  col_types = cols(
    Location  = col_character(),
    Latitude  = col_double(),
    Longitude = col_double(),
    Count     = col_double()
  )
)

# Shift to world2 longitudes (0..360) and add Mid AU–NZ hub
df_world2 <- df %>%
  mutate(
    lon_world2 = if_else(Longitude < 0, Longitude + 360, Longitude),
    lat        = Latitude
  ) %>%
  add_row(
    Location   = "Mid AU-NZ",
    lon_world2 = 163,
    lat        = -37,
    Count      = 1
  )

# Ensure Spain exists and appears as size=7 samples
if (!"Spain" %in% df_world2$Location) {
  df_world2 <- df_world2 %>%
    add_row(
      Location   = "Spain",
      lon_world2 = if_else(-3.7492 < 0, -3.7492 + 360, -3.7492),  # 356.2508
      lat        = 40.4637,
      Count      = 7
    )
} else {
  df_world2 <- df_world2 %>%
    mutate(Count = if_else(Location == "Spain", 7, Count))
}

# Basemap (Pacific-centred), drop Antarctica
world2 <- map_data("world2") %>% filter(region != "Antarctica")


##### 2) Build hubs & edge tables


# AU/NZ targets from Mid AU–NZ
aus_nz_locs <- c("New South Wales","Northern Territory","Queensland",
                 "South Australia","Victoria","Western Australia","New Zealand")

mid     <- df_world2 %>% filter(Location == "Mid AU-NZ") %>% slice(1)
targets <- df_world2 %>% filter(Location %in% aus_nz_locs)

edges_mid_to_targets <- targets %>%
  mutate(
    x    = mid$lon_world2, y    = mid$lat,
    xend = lon_world2,     yend = lat,
    curvature = scales::rescale(row_number(), to = c(-0.35, 0.35))
  )

# PNW centroid (Washington + Oregon)
pnw <- df_world2 %>%
  filter(Location %in% c("Washington (state)", "Oregon")) %>%
  summarise(
    lon_world2 = mean(lon_world2, na.rm = TRUE),
    lat        = mean(lat,        na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  mutate(Location = "PNW centroid")

# Edge: PNW → Mid AU–NZ (steelblue, thick)
edge_pnw_to_mid <- tibble(
  x    = pnw$lon_world2, y    = pnw$lat,
  xend = mid$lon_world2, yend = mid$lat
)

# Red edges: PNW → Peru, Peru:Lima, Spain
dest_red <- df_world2 %>%
  filter(Location %in% c("Peru", "Peru:Lima", "Spain")) %>%
  select(Location, lon_world2, lat)

edges_pnw_to_red <- dest_red %>%
  transmute(
    x    = pnw$lon_world2, y    = pnw$lat,
    xend = lon_world2,     yend = lat,
    Location
  )

# Split Spain edge for custom colour
edges_pnw_to_red_other <- edges_pnw_to_red %>% filter(Location != "Spain")
edge_pnw_to_spain      <- edges_pnw_to_red %>% filter(Location == "Spain")

# Atlantic NE hub (closer to US coast) and burnt-orange targets
atl_ne <- tibble(
  Location   = "Atlantic NE",
  lon_world2 = if_else(-72 < 0, -72 + 360, -72),  # -72° → 288
  lat        = 38
)

atl_targets <- df_world2 %>%
  filter(Location %in% c(
    "Massachusetts","Connecticut","Maryland","South Carolina",
    "Indiana","Iowa","Florida","New York","Virginia",
    "Michigan","Utah","Tennessee","Illinois"
  ))

edges_atl_to_states <- atl_targets %>%
  mutate(
    x    = atl_ne$lon_world2, y    = atl_ne$lat,
    xend = lon_world2,        yend = lat,
    curvature = scales::rescale(row_number(), to = c(-0.3, 0.3))
  )

# PNW → selected regions (purple). Accept both spellings of Montana
pnw_targets <- df_world2 %>%
  filter(Location %in% c(
    "British Columbia","Washington (state)","Connecticut","New York",
    "Alberta","Alaska","California","Oregon",
    "Illinois","Montana","Montanna","Tennessee","Minnesota","Utah"
  ))

edges_pnw_purple <- pnw_targets %>%
  mutate(
    x    = pnw$lon_world2, y    = pnw$lat,
    xend = lon_world2,     yend = lat,
    curvature = scales::rescale(row_number(), to = c(-0.3, 0.3))
  )


##### 3) Plot all flows in one graphic


maps_st36 <- ggplot() +
  # Basemap
  geom_polygon(
    data = world2,
    aes(x = long, y = lat, group = group),
    fill = "grey95", color = "grey70", linewidth = 0.2
  ) +
  # Burnt orange: Atlantic NE → selected US states
  geom_curve(
    data = edges_atl_to_states,
    aes(x = x, y = y, xend = xend, yend = yend, curvature = curvature),
    linewidth = 0.7, alpha = 0.9, lineend = "round",
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(6, "pt"), type = "closed"),
    color = "black"
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = atl_ne,
    aes(x = lon_world2, y = lat),
    shape = 18, size = 3, color = "black"
  ) +
  # Purple: PNW → selected regions
  geom_curve(
    data = edges_pnw_purple,
    aes(x = x, y = y, xend = xend, yend = yend, curvature = curvature),
    linewidth = 0.8, alpha = 0.9, lineend = "round",
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(6, "pt"), type = "closed"),
    color = "black"
  ) +
  geom_point(data = pnw, aes(x = lon_world2, y = lat),
             shape = 17, size = 3, color = "black") +
  # Red: PNW → Peru & Peru:Lima (thicker)
  geom_curve(
    data = edges_pnw_to_red_other,
    aes(x = x, y = y, xend = xend, yend = yend),
    curvature = 0.18, linewidth = 2, alpha = 0.95, lineend = "round",
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(7, "pt"), type = "closed"),
    color = "red"
  ) +
  # Spain edge in custom colour #dfc27d (thicker)
  geom_curve(
    data = edge_pnw_to_spain,
    aes(x = x, y = y, xend = xend, yend = yend),
    curvature = 0.18, linewidth = 2, alpha = 0.95, lineend = "round",
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(7, "pt"), type = "closed"),
    color = "brown"
  ) +
  # Steelblue: PNW → Mid AU–NZ (thicker) and Mid AU–NZ → AU/NZ
  geom_curve(
    data = edge_pnw_to_mid,
    aes(x = x, y = y, xend = xend, yend = yend),
    curvature = 0.25, linewidth = 2, alpha = 0.9, lineend = "round",
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(7, "pt"), type = "closed"),
    color = "steelblue"
  ) +
  geom_curve(
    data = edges_mid_to_targets,
    aes(x = x, y = y, xend = xend, yend = yend, curvature = curvature),
    linewidth = 0.45, alpha = 0.85, lineend = "round",
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(6, "pt"), type = "closed"),
    color = "steelblue"
  ) +
  # Points (Mid AU–NZ = red, AU/NZ = steelblue, others black)
  geom_point(
    data = df_world2 %>%
      mutate(color_group = case_when(
        Location == "Mid AU-NZ" ~ "mid",
        Location %in% aus_nz_locs ~ "aunz",
        TRUE ~ "other"
      )),
    aes(x = lon_world2, y = lat, size = Count, color = color_group),
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(mid = "red", aunz = "steelblue", other = "black"),
                     guide = "none") +
  scale_size_area(max_size = 5, breaks = c(1, 5, 10, 25, 50)) +
  coord_quickmap(xlim = c(100, 365), ylim = c(-60, 74)) +
  labs(
    title = "Global movement of ST36",
    size  = "Count"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), axis.text = element_blank())


maps_st36


##### 4) Save figure output 

ggsave("ST36_world_movement.pdf", maps_st36, width = 12, height = 8)
